mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 3-month moving average signals an economic slowdown, causing investors to sell equities and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between the 3-month relative decline in INDPRO and 20-day S&P 500 returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.0% indicates a deepening labor market crisis, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a collapse in consumer demand, triggering a flight from equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS (measured by the product of their 3-month relative declines) has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a liquidity trap regime (FEDFUNDS <= 2.0%), the inability of monetary policy to stimulate the economy leads to negative equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS <= 2.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 6-month moving average indicates weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between the 6-month relative decline in PAYEMS and 20-day S&P 500 returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low annualized inflation rate (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) signals deflationary pressures, which are associated with negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate is below 2.0%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) relative to its 12-month moving average signals a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days (approximately one quarter).
failure_condition: The correlation between the 12-month relative decline in GDPC1 and 60-day S&P 500 returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A very low annualized inflation rate (CPIAUCSL < 1.5%) signals deflation, which is associated with negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy faces a deflationary spiral.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate is below 1.5%, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of such instances.
